section: The base / Housing, care, pension and ordinary spending credits
guide_wording: **Professional-caregiver qualification, Gipuzkoa; separate Álava route.** DF 33/2014 article 63 bis incorporates DF 6/2023 article 11.3(f) and its first transitional provision, or replacement law. Its express list covers the nursing-assistant and dependency-care technician titles/equivalents, institutional/home sociocare certificates and the legacy home-help certificate described above, plus subsequently published qualifications with the same professional effects. It does not expressly include Bizkaia's broader social-integration/higher-degree categories: establish a separate published-equivalence or valid authority-certificate route before treating a different credential as sufficient. The incorporated first transitional provision requires an actual competent Basque/other autonomous-community **exceptional habilitation certificate**: as at 11 August 2022, the person must meet the three-year/2,000-hour experience route in the professional category of personal assistant in the preceding 12 years or the alternative worked-plus-300-hours relevant-training route for that period and the competencies being accredited. Its provisional exemption expressly ended on 31 December 2023; a former provisional certificate alone does not establish 2026 entitlement. This incorporation concerns professional qualification, not every unrelated condition for the separate social-care benefit. Equal sharing remains: two otherwise eligible B/G taxpayers share EUR 500 as EUR 250 each. Álava article 81 ter instead gives the statutory EUR 250, shared equally, with no professional EUR 500 uplift; do not import either B/G list as an Álava household-credit enhancement. Its distinct article 81 bis personal-assistant credit and same-person incompatibility remain separate. [G DF 33/2014 article 63 bis](https://www.gipuzkoa.eus/documents/2456431/8.0755457E7/DF%2033-2014%20(2026-2).pdf/7e4c25eb-a139-fa5f-d310-deaa4c4bcffd), [actual G DF 6/2023 article 11.3(f)/DT1](https://egoitza.gipuzkoa.eus/gao-bog/castell/bog/2023/04/28/c2302940.pdf), [current qualification body](https://egoitza.gipuzkoa.eus/ogasuna/normativa/docs/0001288c.pdf), [Álava article 81 ter](https://web.araba.eus/documents/d/araba/indice_norma-foral_irpf_cas-4-pdf).
